name: Adam S.
quote: I joined for the planes. I stayed because this is the only place on campus where a sketch on a whiteboard becomes something that flies three months later.

name: Ihsane A.
quote: My first astronomy night with the club telescope changed how I look at the sky. Now I help run them.

name: Wissal A.
quote: Organizing Space Day taught me more about teamwork and logistics than any course. And the atmosphere on event day is unreal.

name: Taha S.
quote: Pitching the club to aerospace companies as a student is intimidating — until you realize how seriously they take us.
